ok.description: True when profilePresent and routePresent are both true, independently of statePresent.

profilePresent.description: Whether the compiled Caduceus carapace is an object.

statePresent.description: Whether the Harmonia profile index for the declared appliance profile is a readable file.

routePresent.description: Whether the carapace declares the update_now Harmonia route.

firstMissingSignal.description: none when ok is true; caduceus-carapace-desync when the profile is absent, otherwise caduceus-harmonia-route-missing:update_now when the route is absent.

load_context.description: Optional HTTP trace response: an appliance.load.context.v1 object or a trace_unavailable diagnostic object.

read.description: A status observation uses this schema even when ok is false. Gate and worker errors use caduceus.api.error.v1 instead.

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
